transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I’ve just been feeling low for a long time. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling, and it kind of stays with me through the day, even before I get to the clinic.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… two years, a little more. Maybe two years and two months. It started around when the clinic staffing changed and my schedule got all over the place.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before you started feeling this way?
I don’t know… I guess I haven’t really paid attention to that. Things just feel kind of flat, but I’m not sure.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I still do some things, but I don’t know if I’d say I enjoy them the same way. It’s hard to tell.
Can you think of anything that you still find pleasure in doing?
Not really… nothing comes to mind right now. I mean, I do things, but I don’t know if I’d call it pleasure.
Are there things that you used to enjoy that you no longer find enjoyable?
I’m not sure… maybe. I haven’t really thought about it that way. Things just don’t feel like much lately, I guess.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to care about?
I don’t know… maybe a little. It’s hard to say if I’ve lost interest or if I just don’t feel much about things lately.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that would normally bring you happiness?
I’m not really sure. I guess things don’t make me happy the way they maybe should, but… I don’t know if I’d say I’m unable to feel pleasure. It’s just kind of hard to tell.
Do you feel like things that used to make you happy no longer bring you any happiness?
I don’t know… I guess some things feel kind of flat, but I’m not sure I’d say they bring me no happiness at all. It’s hard to tell.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that you used to enjoy?
I’m not sure. I mean… some stuff doesn’t really hit the same, but I don’t know if I’d say I’m unable to feel pleasure.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that normally would bring you happiness?
I don’t really know how to answer that. I mean, I still can feel… something sometimes, I think. It’s just not very clear.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… I think I already said, it’s hard for me to tell. Some things feel muted, I guess, but I wouldn’t say I’m completely unable to enjoy anything.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past two years?
Not really… I don’t think so. I haven’t been tracking it closely or anything.
Have you been having any problems with your sleep?
I’m not sure… I haven’t really paid close attention to it. Some nights are better than others, I guess.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?
I… I’m not sure how to answer that. I don’t really want to get into it right now.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself that you feel comfortable sharing with me?
I don’t know… I’d rather not really talk about that right now.
Have you been having any thoughts of self-harm or suicide?
I… I don’t really know. I don’t want to talk about that.
Have you been having any thoughts of wanting to end your life?
I… I don’t know. I’m not really ready to talk about that.
Are you having any thoughts of wanting to end your life right now?
I… I’m not sure. I don’t really want to get into it right now.
Are you having any thoughts of wanting to end your life right now?
I… I don’t really know how to answer that right now. I’m not sure.
